name: agentskillguard
description: AgentSkillGuard — a static security scanner for AI agent tools (MCP tools, plugins, skills) before they are allowed to touch a Solana wallet.

scripts.scan:demo:malicious: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan examples/malicious-tool -p policies/example-swap-agent.yaml
scripts.scan:demo:safe: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan examples/safe-tool -p policies/example-swap-agent.yaml
